title: Validate response
description: The verdict for each run checked. A run is `valid` if every check performed passed; `engine_checked` says whether the engine dry run was among them, so a verdict made without the engine is never mistaken for one made with it.

engine_check.description: The level that was requested: `none` or `dry_run`.

runs.description: One verdict per run, in the order of the recipe's sensor list; one entry for a run spec.

name.description: The run's name, its `descriptor.meta.name`, or null if the run spec has none.

run_id.description: The run id the run spec would be submitted under, or null if the run spec could not be resolved (its sensor could not be materialized).

valid.description: True if every check performed passed.

engine_checked.description: True only if the DIRSIG dry run was performed. False at `engine_check: none`, and false at `dry_run` if the dry run could not be attempted because an earlier check failed.

checks.description: The outcome of each check, in the order they run. A check that was not performed is absent.

check.description: `schema`: the document is valid `run-spec/1`. `resolution`: every reference resolves to a library file. `content_hash`: each referenced file matches its stamped content hash. `library_files`: the files the run needs are present and match. `dry_run`: DIRSIG accepts the assembled job.

errors.description: Why the check failed, each with the authored file and field at fault where they can be named; empty if it passed.
